item.title: Panorama releases more dodgy Trump clips
item.description: The BBC’s Panorama programme announced today it has some more clips of President Trump saying awful things. The clips appear to show Trump admitting the moon landings were faked, confessing to being the Boston Strangler, encouraging John Wilkes-Booth to assassinate Abraham Lincoln and telling the residents of Pompeii not to worry as 'Vesuvius always makes noises like that.'
